summary: Iteration 4 testing — all 5 surgical fixes for B Livre / ADM scope verified PASSING. Backend 8/8 pytest green for /api/admin/reports/{id}/respond push-to-admin_responses[] flow plus existing /api/public/support and /api/admin/support regression. Frontend Playwright (mobile 390x844 + desktop 1280x800) confirms: (1) /blivre logout via [data-testid=blivre-logout-btn] inside settings opens BLivreAuthModal directly without leaving /blivre — verified URL stays at /blivre and 'Bem-vindo à B-Livre' visible; (2) mobile composer-modal h-[100dvh] occupies full 390x844 viewport with [data-testid=blivre-back-from-composer] visible and back closes modal; desktop composer is exactly 560px wide, rounded md:rounded-[28px] with gold border; (3) PWAInstallButton always rendered ([data-testid=pwa-install-btn] count=2 — sm in settings + standalone), click opens [data-testid=pwa-install-help-modal] with platform-specific install instructions, [data-testid=pwa-install-dismiss] present; (4) Mobile back arrows visible+functional for showSettings, showNotifications, showSupportModal, composer (all 4 verified), product back-testid present in source; (5) ADM Denúncias /admin/blivre/denuncias lists 'Ver detalhes' [data-testid=bl-open-report-{id}], opens [data-testid=bl-report-drawer] with full timeline 'HISTÓRICO DE RESPOSTAS', [data-testid=bl-report-response-input] + [data-testid=bl-report-send-response] work, drawer reflects new entry after sending, Resolver/Ignorar/Bloquear-usuário buttons visible. Backend $push admin_responses[] confirmed: 2 sequential responds yield array of length 2 with {by:'admin', message, created_at}. Marketplace pages NOT touched.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/admin/reports/{id}/respond correctly uses $push for admin_responses[] while keeping legacy admin_response field updated to last reply — clean dual-write strategy.
Status auto-promotion from pending → analyzed only triggers when current status is in ['pending','pendente'] — preserves resolved/ignored/blocked terminal states. Good defensive coding.
Reports.jsx drawer 'Ver detalhes' renders timeline by combining legacy admin_response with admin_responses[] — handles old data gracefully.

Settings gear button in SocialPage.js (3 mount points: line 2191/2222/2262) lacks a data-testid attribute. Tests had to use 'button:has(svg.lucide-settings)' fallback. Minor — recommend adding data-testid='blivre-settings-btn' for stability.
PWAInstallButton mounts twice in DOM (sizes 'sm' inside settings + standalone) — fine functionally but yields two pwa-install-btn nodes; tests must account for this when asserting visibility.

Composer modal correctly toggles full-screen on mobile (h-[100dvh], rounded-none, border-0) vs constrained desktop (md:max-w-[560px], md:h-[92vh], md:rounded-[28px], md:border) — verified visually and via class string + bbox (560x736 on desktop 1280x800).
